system_result: One actual local entrypoint for existing package save, receipt recovery, typed reads and lexical search; preserve immutable command/identity/snapshot semantics without introducing a new data protocol.
application_result: Synthetic callable local CLI/controller routes bank.save, collection.save, five accepted reads and bank.search to existing components; explicit cache maintenance. Existing READY packages only; producer/editor and visible UI are subsequent tasks.

acceptance_checks.check: Independent full card/contract review first; select strict bounded CLI commands/controller inputs/results with trusted operator root configuration. Preserve local-bank-intake/1 and local-bank-query/1; no write commands added to closed read schema or changes to accepted component sources/canonical DDL/baseline.

Existing private configured intake/stage/Bank/cache/output roots; no caller SQL/destinations/network and no implicit initialization. Save resolves one validated transaction ID through actual secure reader private snapshot, invokes accepted importer once, always closes snapshot; collection.save explicitly restricts operations to Collection without suppressing validation.

Whole-command ACCEPTED/REPLAY/CONFLICT/REJECTED/RETRYABLE_BUSY/UNKNOWN semantics preserved; exact original receipt and manifest hashes. Timeout/retry retains IDs/bytes, never interprets missing receipt as failed or allocates new IDs. Any unsupported outcome remains explicit; do not invent durable failed-attempt history.

Route five typed reads plus bank.search through the same entrypoint; reuse closed parsers/result validators and bounded immutable original exports. Search is separate disposable cache; saves do not become unaccepted if index fails. Explicit maintenance rebuild/profile/error recovery, no silent background rebuild or partial OK.

Independent native fixture enters through actual CLI/controller: package→save→receipt→get→rebuild→search→pinned original→update→old reopen after restart. Test collection-only save, replay after update, mixed/stale-base conflicts, missing/busy/unavailable/limits/unsupported requests and intake removal. No direct helper-only test substitutes for actual entrypoint evidence.

Bounded diagnostics/identity/exit codes/lifecycle on validation/reader/import/export/index faults and interruption. No canonical partial write or generated success on UNKNOWN; owned resources close, intake not deleted. Any mandatory unavailable check blocks completion.

Same-source local then actual Windows integration evidence, protected previous code/264-file baseline hashes, backups/readback. Preserve issue open→resolved history, Review Log, receipt and continuation pointer. Next producer/UI/deployment remain pending; no R0/R1 release acceptance.

pre_execution_questions.question: How should save commands coexist with the closed read protocol at one entrypoint?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Use explicit CLI subcommands/controller dispatch for existing package saves; read requests retain local-bank-query/1 unchanged. Trusted roots are operator configuration; request identity is not a filesystem destination. Review exact input/result mapping before implementation.

pre_execution_questions.question: Should saving rebuild search automatically?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Keep canonical acceptance and disposable indexing separate: save returns importer outcome, explicit rebuild advances index; stale index remains INDEX_NOT_READY. Automatic scheduling and UI can be a subsequent reviewed step.
